## Summary

Describe the problem, the user-visible change and any related issue.

## Scope

Explain what changed and what intentionally did not. Keep product changes
separate from conference decks, speaker notes and promotional materials.

## Verification

List the commands and scenarios you actually ran, their results and any checks
you could not run. Distinguish offline fixtures from live-provider or physical
hardware verification. Never include credentials or private session output.

- [ ] I ran `npm run verify`, or explained which checks could not run and why.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant regression tests and documentation.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for secrets, live capability keys, captures and datasets.
- [ ] I kept recording opt-in and preserved existing safety checks.

## Risks and limitations

Describe compatibility changes, known limitations and recovery considerations.
For substantial changes, summarize the pre-change and post-change review.
